stem: Mapleton Freight has years of Terraform state in the default local backend and now adds a `cloud` block to move to HCP Terraform. What completes the migration of that state?

choices.text: Keep the existing `backend` block beside the `cloud` block until the state has moved
Run `terraform login` again and let the saved token move the state
Run `terraform init` and accept the prompt to migrate the existing state
Destroy the resources locally and apply the configuration again in HCP Terraform

rationale: After adding or changing a `cloud` block, running `terraform init` completes the setup, and if the directory has existing state Terraform prompts you to migrate it from the existing workspaces. A `backend` block cannot be configured when the configuration also contains a `cloud` configuration, so keeping both is not possible. `terraform login` only obtains an API token and does not move state. Destroying and re-applying would remove real infrastructure and recreate it, which is unnecessary because init migrates the state in place.
